تضطغنوا (form VIII)

# تُضْطَغَنُوا (tuḍṭaḡanū) /tudˤ.tˤa.ɣa.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
